answer_2.quote: We use the following metrics. • PPL reflects the average density of samples from test set in a generative model. • Rev-PPL is a good indicator for both sample quality and diversity, • EMD-l is the earth mover distance between sentence lengths of real and generated data. • EMD-f is the earth mover distance between word frequencies of real and generated data.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation Score is added to reflect the comprehensive sample quality. We ask 4 volunteers to select a score from {0, 0.5, 1} for each sample according to their fluency and coherence with the target style.
